initialExam.title: IB ACIO (Intelligence Bureau) 2026
initialExam.description: Intelligence Bureau ACIO Grade-II exam for intelligence officers. Prestigious intelligence and security agency of India.
initialExam.syllabus: Tier-I: General Awareness (40Q), Quant Aptitude (20Q), Logical/Analytical Ability (20Q), English (20Q). Tier-II: Descriptive English. Tier-III: Interview.
initialExam.examPattern: Tier-I: 100Q, 100 marks, 1 hour. Tier-II: Descriptive, 50 marks, 1 hour. Tier-III: Interview, 100 marks.
initialExam.careerGrowth: ACIO → Field Officer → Deputy Director → Joint Director → Director.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit MHA recruitment page 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Intelligence Allowance, Medical, Pension, Security clearance benefits
